name: WooCsvFix — WooCommerce Product CSV Pre-Flight Checker & Fixer, Re-Checked (Local, Private)
description:
How do I check my WooCommerce product CSV before importing, so a bad file doesn't silently skip rows or overwrite my products? It silently skips rows, imports prices as nothing, orphans variations — and when two rows share a SKU, it doesn't create your new product at all: it overwrites the old one. You find out from your storefront, or from a customer.
WooCsvFix is the pre-flight check you run BEFORE importing. Format errors are fixed automatically; anything that needs a human decision is listed as a blocking issue with its line number; and the fixed file is re-parsed to prove no fixable problem remains.
FIXED AUTOMATICALLY
• Prices with currency symbols or thousands commas ($1,299.00 → 1299.00)
• Mixed-case product types, Published / In-stock values written as yes/no/draft, stray whitespace
FLAGGED AS BLOCKING — NEVER SILENTLY "FIXED"
• Duplicate SKUs (the importer would UPDATE your existing product)
• Variations whose parent SKU is missing from the file
• Sale price higher than the regular price
• Image paths that aren't URLs, empty product names, non-numeric stock
VERIFIED, NOT VIBES
On a seeded 9-product CSV with 10 planted defects: exactly 5 automatic fixes and exactly 5 blocking issues, all 9 rows preserved in order, and the re-check of the fixed file found 0 remaining fixable problems.
100% LOCAL — it reads the CSV, not your store. No WordPress login, no upload, no subscription. Import-plugin suites charge $59-$229 a year; this is $29 once.
Windows 10/11, no other software needed. You get products_fixed.csv and the pre-flight report.
